name: VRM_POL_BILLING_EVENTS
description: This table contains performance obligation line billing events information for customer contract.

columns.name: POL_BILLING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Billing event unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line identifier to which this event belongs.

columns.name: BILLING_LINE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Billing line detail unique identifier pointing to the billing record coming from the billing system.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of billing event.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation line billing event is processed or not. Blank indicates processed. N indicates not processed.

columns.name: PROCESSED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that processed this row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BILLING_DATA_JOB_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that will be processing this row for accounting events creation. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the batch to be processed for creation of accounting events. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
